verdict.rationale: The feedback widget lets a customer point at an element and attach an optional screenshot with metadata so 'the model fixes the right thing' (foreloop-docs-21), which is adjacent to the story but is customer-bug-report flow, not a developer attaching an annotated mockup directly to a task. There's no documentation of markup/annotation tools, mockup uploads, or a developer-facing task-attachment workflow for visual specs. Missing for 10: developer-facing screenshot/mockup attachment to tasks, annotation/markup capability, and evidence the agent parses visual markup to implement precise UI changes.
